name: Kuro to Hakaba
source:
When "I" woke up, I found myself in a "graveyard of stuffed animals."
There I met Kuro, a stuffed animal who had taken the shape of a boy.
This is a place where stuffed animals abandoned by humans end up.
But "I" was supposed to have been cherished.
In exchange for being shown the way home, "I" answer Kuro's questions. 
What kind of ending will "I" reach at the end of this conversation with him?

[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/kurohaka.html]official website[/url]]
